items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Tommy Morris and Bubber Miley, it was lowdown. ... Bubba wasn't a good musician as far as reading was concerned.

ctx.x: Yeah. See, so, but Johnny, Johnny, had it a little different from the others, because he was more so- wa-wa-ooed sophisticated wow-wow. In other words, he wow-wowed with-double.* But Tommy Morris and Bubber Miley, it was lowdown. What we called then the gutbucket, you see?
